description: Get an exact human Reactome R-HSA or WikiPathways WP card. Read whole summary, genes, Reactome events or bounded all sections. Membership names a source and release; it implies no therapy, response or actionability. No enrichment is calculated.

id.description: Exact human Reactome or WikiPathways identity without version suffixes.

pool.description: Retained snapshot, when continuing a source relation.

section.description: Omit for the card; WikiPathways has summary and genes sections.

section_limit.description: Bounded initial section size; each all section has its own first page.

section_offset.description: Native relation offset for a selected genes or events section.
